device.name: pixium_4600
device.model: PIXIUM 4600 flat panel, fixed radiograph on a turntable (not a C-arm)
device.dataset: Ljubljana 2D-3D gold standard (Tomazevic 2002): cadaver L1-L5 in a water tube, 18 radiographs at 20 deg steps, CT with fiducial gold standard
device.orientation_convention: detector axes (n, s) handedness settled per frame by NCC over the four sign choices (tools/ljubljana_pairs.py); supplied frames are 2x subsampled, 3x3 median filtered

kb.bound_source: 0.5-2.5: the bone-path scale a 60-150 kVp Kramers spectrum needs against the repo's ~100 kVp six-energy spectrum spans ~0.6-1.6 (device_physics.kb_default); the box is opened to 2.5 because DeepFluoro under the old reading pinned at 2.5 and under the linear reading sits at 2.0

s.bound_source: 0-0.75: scatter fraction s = SPR/(1+SPR) for SPR 0-3 (gridless pelvis, Siewerdsen & Jaffray 2001)

sigma_s.bound_source: 4.5-12.5 mm: the box that made the term identifiable on DeepFluoro (6-16 px at 0.776 mm); wider boxes ran 5-60 px across folds

sigma_r.bound_source: 0.2-2.4 mm: scintillator + binning blur of CsI / GOS panels and intensifiers (device_physics.SCINT_SIGMA_MM), up to a 2x2-binned II

alpha.bound_source: 0-2: unsharp-mask gain, none to twice the high-pass

sigma_u.bound_source: 0.75-6.2 mm: unsharp radius 1-40 px at 0.15-0.2 mm native pitch

b.bound_source: -0.6..0.6: radial gain at the field corner, from -60 % (an intensifier's vignetting is ~-25 %) to +60 %

c.bound_source: -0.3..0.3: anode-heel gradient across the field, |c| ~0.07 physically

kb.how: kVp not recorded for this device; the default at 70 / 90 / 110 kVp is given instead

s.how: SPR 0.40 for 10 cm water, 12 cm field at the patient, grid=None (Siewerdsen & Jaffray 2001, order of magnitude)

sigma_r.how: csi_fpd scintillator sigma + binning box, in fit px

sigma_p.how: focal 0.6 mm, collimator 150.0 mm from the source (assumed), SID 1009.6

c.how: |c| ~0.07 across a 30 cm field at 1 m; sign not predictable

b.how: flat panel with vendor flat-field: no vignette expected

alpha.how: display unsharp gain: from the images alone (edge halo), see display_stage.from_images

sigma_u.how: display unsharp radius: from the images alone (edge halo), see display_stage.from_images

window.or_targets: 27/47/126/216/239 at percentiles 1/5/50/95/99 (FluoroCap medians) for the 8-bit display

penumbra_default.how: focal 0.6 mm, collimator 150.0 mm from the source (assumed), SID 1009.6

border.measured_on: the real frames' borders (device_physics.border_profile), all frames; the penumbra term in the forward model is fitted in term_tests['+penumbra']

per_fold.joint_boxes_note: 'joint' above = inside every term's 1-99 % box at once (a product over terms; not the statistic to quote)

typicality.how: Mahalanobis distance of the frame's copula normal scores against the 99th percentile of the sampler's own draws on the same terms
